يستفهمان (form X)
# يَسْتَفْهِمَانِ (yastafhimāni) /jas.taf.hi.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# يُسْتَفْهَمَانِ (yustafhamāni) /jus.taf.ha.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
